The research flags an open Nextcloud resource-booking privacy issue ([issue #196](https://github.com/nextcloud/calendar_resource_management/issues/196)) and records LibreBooking’s patched v7.0.0 release alongside the security advisory ([GHSA](https://github.com/LibreBooking/librebooking/security/advisories/GHSA-3356-vjx2-5pg8), [release](https://github.com/LibreBooking/librebooking/releases/tag/v7.0.0)). The assignment calls for three fresh contexts, but also prohibits nested agents and specifies one native Goal. I documented that the critic and revision passes occurred within the same Goal, so they cannot be claimed as independently fresh contexts.
